name: The Red Feast
about: A great lord invites a rival house to a wedding feast to end their feud, and you're invited too. A servant whispers that the music is a signal. Go, warn them, or stay away and let it happen.
title: The Red Feast at {hall}

beats.speaker: host
beats.text: {host} invites {guest} and all of {guest.house} to a wedding at {hall} to end the feud between them. The King is invited too.

court.text: {guest} of {guest.house}: "{host} is offering peace and a wedding, Your Grace, and I'm going to accept. Will you come to the feast?"

options.label: Go to the wedding
options.result: The King accepts. {host} sends word that the best rooms in {hall} are being made ready.

options.label: Send gifts but stay at Kingsmere
options.result: The crown sends silver and its apologies. The wedding goes ahead without the King.

beats.speaker: host
beats.text: A kitchen girl from {hall} reaches Kingsmere half dead from riding. She says that when the musicians play the old wedding song, {host}'s men will bar the doors.

court.text: A servant girl kneels, shaking: "Your Grace, my lord {host} is going to murder them all at the feast. When the music changes, the doors close."

options.label: Warn {guest} in secret
options.result: A royal rider catches {guest} on the road to {hall}. {guest.house} turns back.

options.label: Ride to {hall} with your guard and sit at the high table (200 gold)
options.result: The King arrives at {hall} with a hundred guards. {host} smiles and tells the musicians to play something else.

options.label: Stay out of it and let them settle their feud
options.hint: costs nothing now · the music plays
options.result: The King says nothing. The girl is sent back to {hall}.

beats.speaker: host
beats.text: The musicians play the old wedding song. The doors of {hall} close, and the lords of {guest.house} die at the table. People will call it the Red Feast for a hundred years.

die.how: murdered at the Red Feast in {hall}

court.text: {host} kneels with blood still under {host.his} nails: "It's done, Your Grace. {guest.house} was a threat to your peace. All I ask is your pardon, and {guesthall}."

options.label: Pardon {host}
options.hint: {host.houseName} +15 · every house learns what you'll let them get away with
options.result: The King pardons {host}. From now on, no great lord will go to a wedding without a hundred swords.

options.label: Declare {host} a murderer and an outlaw
options.hint: {host.houseName} −40 · {host} has an army and nothing to lose
options.result: Heralds shout {host}'s crime in every town. In {hall}, {host} sharpens the swords that did it.

beats.speaker: host
beats.text: Now that {host} is an outlaw with nothing left to lose, {host} marches on Kingsmere with the swords from the Red Feast.

beats.speaker: guest
beats.text: There's no Red Feast. {guest.house} survives, owes the crown its life, and never sits at {host}'s table again.

beats.speaker: host
beats.text: {host} keeps {guesthall} and the King's pardon. The realm doesn't forget, and the crown is stuck with a lord who knows it can be bought.
The army of the Red Feast's murderer breaks at Kingsmere. The dead of {guest.house} get their justice.
